main_text.l: rum Patrum, magnus Tertullianei nominis æstimator, martyrio sublatus tertio nonnihil inclinante sæculo, Epistolam ad Hebræos ut Paulinam citat, Libro de Cardinal. Operibus Christi ad Cornelium. Quod licet opus, Possevinus, & Erasmus Cypriano affectum censent, refert sane in plurimis genium Cypriani, & pervetustum esse in confesso est. Pariter inter opera Cypriani, & sub ejus nomine, habetur Expositio in symbolum Apostolorum (Ruffino aliàs adscripta) cujus articul.36. inter Novi Testamenti Libros recensentur Pauli Apostoli Epistolæ quatuordecim. Quod excipitur, nusquam usurpari Epistolam Cypriano in scriptis confessis & ἀδιάθετος[?], infrà notamus.

V. Arnobius Presbyter, Philosophus & Rhetor, quarto ineunte sæculo in Africa celebratus, Commentario in Psalmum civ. (si modo Arnobij est, ex Trithemij, Erasmi aliorumque etiam mente) citaturus Caput vi. Epistolæ ad Hebræos, Paulus clamat Hebræus ex Hebræis. Libris vero vii. adversus Gentes Epi-

page.notes: The Greek word after "&" is hard to read; ἀδιάθετος is a likely reading but is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The Roman numerals "vi." and "vii." are copied as lowercase, as they appear in the scan. The line ends with the catchword "Epi-", which is also at the foot of the page. The reference "articul.36." is set as printed.
